method: 24 paired seeds in each predeclared regime. Intervals are 2,000 resamples of paired primary-outcome differences. Null values are excluded from numeric aggregates and retain explicit valid counts. No biological or physical validation is implied.

regimes.label: Enough for everyone
regimes.description: Stable patches reward repeated routes, until useful routes become crowded.

regimes.label: The last crumbs
regimes.description: Small patches deplete quickly. Yesterday’s good information may waste today’s energy.

regimes.label: Hazard corridor
regimes.description: Foraging traffic crosses a damaging corridor. A popular route may amplify exposure.

regimes.label: The feast moves
regimes.description: Remaining food shifts halfway through the run while old memories and traces remain.

regimes.label: No trace survives
regimes.description: Signaling spends energy but environmental traces vanish; compare against local memory.
